correctness.rationale: For full hypercube adjacency A=sum_i S_i, commuting involutions give A²=dI in characteristic two; one-vertex compression A=[[0,b^T],[b,B]] gives Bb=0 and B²=(d mod 2)I+bb^T. A+εI has rank N/2 from the two-halves block decomposition. When d even, rank B=N/2, B²=bb^T has rank one, B³=0, giving precisely J3(0)⊕J2(0)^(N/2−2). For odd d, b^Tb=1, B²=I+bb^T projects onto b-perp with zero line b, and restriction is involutory with N/2−1 Jordan J2(1) blocks. Kernel/rank counts yield all displayed first-entry, fixed-point and primitive period-two formulas for every q=2^f. Independently checked exact binary-matrix powers/ranks for d=2..7, and inspected both provided enumeration scripts; finite calculations corroborate rather than prove all-d and all-field conclusions. An earlier published complete proof establishes identical formulas.
residual_risks: Exact classification only for one vertex deletion in characteristic two; odd-characteristic matrices and additional punctures can differ.
